content.title: Photo introduction plus random text idea exchange
content.summary: Share photos, then exchange one randomly assigned non-self text idea and linked text response.
content.setup: Enroll a fixed roster; the host binds a saved seed for text assignment.
content.participant: Submit one ready photo and one text idea, then respond to your assigned text source.
content.completion: Text sources and responses close at their respective fixed relative deadlines.
content.access: Photos reveal after the first form; assigned text and own responses remain private until linked-result reveal. Photos are not assignment sources.

provenance.credit: Constructed Harmonomicon candidate 0.19 review arrangement; not source-equivalent or product-endorsed.
provenance.rights: Original review arrangement. Participant media rights and retention are host responsibilities.

steps.prompt: Describe an image or idea in text.
Create a text response to your assigned source.
